method: Outcome codes come from public-only per-item results that exactly reproduce each published v1.4.1 public accuracy. Input length comes from the system's actual usage.input_tokens. Mixed logs are filtered against the 231-item public ID allowlist before JSON parsing; sealed rows are discarded before parsing. Buckets are <2k, 2–8k, 8–16k, 16–64k, 64–256k, 256k–1M, and >=1M.
caveat: Token counts use each system's own rendered request/tokenizer; prompt wrappers can differ. Bucket denominators are shown because token-count coverage is incomplete for some systems.
